title: Microsoft Teams: new chat sections for muted and meeting chats
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Microsoft Learn does not document these sections. The Microsoft Graph beta reference explicitly describes MutedChats and MeetingChats and their supported operations; the briefing should acknowledge that limited documentation without presenting it as a tenant-wide enablement switch. The defaults, rollout window and administrator preparation advice match the supplied records.

claims.fix: Replace the blanket Learn-absence statements with: 'Microsoft Learn's Graph beta teamworkSection reference names MutedChats and MeetingChats and documents limited section operations. The defaults, rollout and user-setting guidance here come from MC1269864.' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/teamworksection?view=graph-rest-beta to sources. Revise After rollout to compare observed behaviour with the notice and monitor documentation updates. Do not equate beta per-user section operations with a tenant enable/disable switch.
